parts.title: Adafruit QT Py CH32V203
parts.label: Adafru
parts.desc:
p, li { white-space: pre-wrap; }
   
  What a cutie pie! Or is it... a QT Py? This diminutive dev board features the powerful CH32V203 low-cost processor that's all the trend: based on RISC-V and cheaper than an 8-bit core! This little one is a great way to get started in the CH32x processor
parts.author: liz
